notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-1.85.0.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - Nut "Khung keo thep" doi vao nhom dropdown Fast Design (khong con dung rieng). - Them 2 addin vao bo cai: "Tao luoi truc" (pick 2 truc bien, tu sinh truc giua theo nhip <= 8 m + dim) va "Bo tri cua so theo truc" (chon tuong, tu dat cua so canh giua moi doan giua 2 truc). - Tuy chon "Tao KHUNG DAU HOI" (mac dinh bat): family rieng "<ten>_DauHoi" dat tai 2 truc chon (mac dinh truc dau va cuoi).
